dict.string: Pisper uses the camera only when you start pairing or approve a photo capture.
Pisper uses the microphone only when you start voice input.
Pisper accesses contacts only for a mobile operation you approve.
Pisper accesses photo metadata only when you approve a photo operation.
Pisper changes your photo library only when you approve a photo operation.
Pisper reads one foreground location only for a mobile operation you approve.
Pisper uses your local network only to discover and connect to a Pisper Desktop Runtime that you choose.
